Class AgentService

java.lang.Object
marius.server.data.AgentService
@Entity public class AgentService extends Object
Represents a service running on an agent, corresponding to the service table in the database.

Note: The ip field must contain an IPv4 address that exists in the Servers table, as it is a foreign key referencing Servers.ip. Using IPv6 addresses is not supported and may cause errors.
